text:
emma_sales: Quick sync - BetaCo wants the pilot contract + security pack. Specific asks: sign DPA+SCCs, confirm DSAR/deletion within 30 days, and clarify snapshot/backups policy. Can we lock answers today?

devin_se: We can provide a CAIQ export and mark controls we fully implement vs those that rely on cloud provider. Which deployment for the pilot? Hosted EU region?

emma_sales: Yes, Hosted (eu-west). They'll run sample traffic for 2 weeks. Also asked if cache and embeddings are persisted and for how long.

paul_security: Short answers: embeddings and KV cache are persisted by default for 24h on Hosted EU. We can add a POC config to disable persistence: set cache.persist=false and embeddings.ttl_seconds=0. Deletion endpoints exist to handle DSARs; primary store deletion happens within 30 days, but snapshots/backups may retain data up to 90 days for IR.

rachel_privacy: Backup retention up to 90 days must be explicitly called out in the DPA, with commitment to honor deletion requests on restored copies. I'll prepare an addendum clause: "Backups: retained up to 90 days solely for disaster recovery; any restored data will be subject to data subject requests and deletion obligations within 30 days of restoration."

emma_sales: Good. BetaCo also asked to remove our "service improvement" processing language. Can we offer an opt-out in contract?

paul_security: We prefer to keep a narrow phrase about aggregated/anonymous telemetry for product safety and performance. Offer: contract opt-out for non-essential analytics, but keep safety telemetry excluded from opt-out. I'll draft recommended language.

infra-bot: Created ticket SLS-BETACO-91, owner: devin_se. Checklist items: DPA redline, CAIQ export, cache.poc config, deletion runbook, pricing quote for 3mo pilot. https://internal/tickets/SLS-BETACO-91

devin_se: I'll fill CAIQ and attach a short mapping doc showing which controls point to which DPA sections. Will include the config snippet for disabling persistence: 
```
features:
  cache:
    persist: false
  embeddings:
    ttl_seconds: 0
```

emma_sales: Thanks all 100. Rachel, once your addendum is ready I'll send the packet. Paul, please include the KMS options in the CAIQ mapping (customer-managed keys note).
